items.promise: Every data check runs before any modelling, and each finding is logged with the decision taken.
items.result: All 15 checks logged; 11 changed the analysis.

items.promise: Every model input is built only from records dated before the cutoff day.
items.result: Checked by a unit test at every cutoff, and again on the three non-test terms: inputs rebuilt from the data as it stood on the cutoff day are identical.

items.promise: The test term (2014J) is scored once, after the model and cut points are frozen.
items.result: Frozen in commit 7601fea, scored once in commit 2b8d230. The frozen files were checked before and after.
items.note: Rules and model settings logged before any model was fitted: https://github.com/Kobi-Lipari/withdrawal-early-warning/commit/5cd50c962b7965d507670adaee283566f2192c79 . Model, calibration and cut points frozen: https://github.com/Kobi-Lipari/withdrawal-early-warning/commit/7601fea03562978ae0eb0768d5f10bdf7169a986 .

items.promise: Any departure from the plan is logged with its reason.
items.result: 22 dated entries in the plan's change log; the rules and settings were logged in commit 5cd50c9 before any model was fitted.

items.promise: Week-4 differences are reported with effect sizes and Holm-corrected tests, not p-values alone.
items.result: Effect sizes are small: rank-biserial r = 0.12 for clicks and 0.13 for active days on all four terms (0.09 and 0.10 on the three non-test terms).

items.promise: On the test term, ROC AUC, PR AUC, Brier score, calibration intercept and slope, and the AUC within each module each come with a student-level bootstrap 95% interval (2,000 resamples).
items.result: All reported with intervals from 2,000 resamples of students, both registrations of a student kept together.

items.promise: Test-term ROC AUC of at least 0.75.
Calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2 on the test term.
items.result: 1.187 (95% CI 1.042 to 1.324) on the calibrated score; the estimate is inside the band and the interval reaches outside it.

items.promise: The model counts as useful only if it clears both bars.
items.result: Not useful by the plan's own definition: the AUC bar is missed.

items.promise: The simpler model wins unless the complex one is better beyond the bootstrap noise.
items.result: Rule applied as logged: boosted trees replaced the logistic regression on a Brier margin whose interval excluded zero. The margin came from one module. On the test term the trees' AUC differs from the logistic regression's by +0.016.

items.promise: Gender, age, disability and deprivation are never model inputs.
items.result: Excluded. Adding them to the logistic model moves test-term AUC by +0.009.

items.promise: Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across gender groups.
items.result: Catch-rate gap 5.7 points (95% CI 1.9 to 10.1); false-alarm gap 5.0 points.

items.promise: Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across age band groups.
items.result: Catch-rate gap 7.0 points (95% CI 2.7 to 11.3); false-alarm gap 4.7 points.

items.promise: Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across disability groups.
items.result: Catch-rate gap 7.3 points (95% CI 1.2 to 13.8); false-alarm gap 2.4 points.

items.promise: Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across deprivation band groups.
items.result: Catch-rate gap 18.7 points (95% CI 12.8 to 35.8); false-alarm gap 3.3 points; the largest minus the smallest of 11 groups, which overstates the true spread.

items.promise: No group miscalibrated by more than 3 points.
items.result: Worst gaps in points: gender 1.1, age band 1.0, disability 6.7, deprivation band 3.8. The largest is for disability.

items.promise: Groups under 100 students are shown but not judged.
items.result: age band 55<=: 87 students. Shown, not judged.

items.promise: Every material gap is reported, and remedies are weighed but never applied automatically.
items.result: 6 material gaps reported with group sizes and intervals. Three remedies weighed; none applied.

items.promise: Students who appear in more than one term stay in, and their share is reported.
items.result: 1,263 test-term students (14.2%) were also in an earlier term.

items.promise: The score is only used to offer support, never to restrict a student.
items.result: Stated in the model card as a condition of use.
